achievement: For a body of poetry, essays and translation that fuses classical scholarship with formally inventive, emotionally intense modern verse, including Autobiography of Red, Nox and The Beauty of the Husband
rationale: This is a speculative pick, since the 2026 prize has not been announced as of October 7, 2026. Recent laureates have alternated by gender (Ernaux, Fosse, Han Kang, Krasznahorkai), which points to a woman this year. The last four winners were European or Asian prose writers, so the Academy may turn to English-language poetry. Carson is a perennial favorite who fits the Academy's taste for formally daring, erudite work. Can Xue, Lyudmila Ulitskaya and Mircea Cărtărescu are plausible alternatives.
